description: Automation Health Dashboard â€” composite view of UI Bridge automation quality. Shows health score gauge, improvement recommendations, element reliability heatmap, action performance baselines, failure taxonomy, automation regressions, stall frequency, intervention effectiveness, and annotation gaps. Powered by cross-run analytics from ui_bridge_events (element interactions persisted per action with duration, success, error). groups.description: Analytics data reflects recent UI Bridge interactions. The dashboard should show non-zero interaction counts within seconds of actions being performed. Changing the time range should filter all panels. The health score should decrease when failures are introduced.

assertions.description: Introducing failed actions should decrease the health score below 100% and trigger recommendations
assertions.expected: After actions with success=false are recorded, the health score should be < 100, the failure taxonomy should show error clusters, and recommendations should appear with actionable guidance.
assertions.precondition: At least one failed UI Bridge action exists in ui_bridge_events (success=0)

assertions.description: Switching time range from 30d to 24h may show different data if interactions span multiple days

groups.name: Backend Data Pipeline Architecture
groups.description: Architecture: UI Bridge action handlers (mcp/ui_bridge.rs, mcp/sdk_client.rs) persist events to ui_bridge_events table via insert_ui_bridge_event() when ?task_run_id= query param is present. Events flow through 17 SQL query functions in database/ui_bridge_ops.rs, exposed via 13 MCP HTTP endpoints under /ui-bridge/analytics/*. The knowledge graph (reflection/graph_engine.rs) loads UIElement nodes and InteractedWith edges for causal analysis. The stall detector (orchestration_loop/stall_detector.rs) fetches /ui-bridge/control/health-signals to detect UIStuck patterns. Token attribution flows through phase_token_usage.target_app. CTR auto-seeding pushes reliability data to SDK apps on connect.

assertions.description: All 13 analytics MCP endpoints respond with {success: true, data: ...} JSON structure, consistent with the ApiResponse pattern used throughout the runner

target.label: All analytics endpoints return valid responses

Tables use text-xs text-muted-foreground headers, py-2 px-3 cell padding, hover:bg-muted/50 row highlights, and tabular-nums for numeric alignment. Charts use h-48 height with ResponsiveContainer. The responsive grid uses grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4.

assertions.description: Each analytics panel is visually contained in a card with border and rounded corners, providing clear visual separation between panels
On medium+ screens, panels are in 2-column grid. On small screens, they stack single-column for readability.
